headline: Kodagu reports lowest teen pregnancies and benefits from malnutrition treatment centre serving multiple districts
summary: Kodagu is among the districts reporting the lowest number of teenage pregnancies in Karnataka. A malnutrition treatment centre at Kollegal hospital under the National Rural Health Scheme serves children from Kodagu, Hassan, Mysore and Chamarajanagar districts, admitting severely malnourished children for 15 days of nutritious food and medical care. A research study was conducted on preschool children in two remote villages of Hassan and Kodagu districts to assess under-nutrition and anemia prevalence. The Women and Child Development Department in Kodagu works to protect children affected by malnutrition and provide health services.
